closure_mapping.source_loose_end: `graph/store.ts::safe`, maintenance and scheduler loaders can collapse load failures to empty state. ADR-095 only justifies known optional bootstrap absence.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Registered optional absence is explicit empty-at-bootstrap; corrupt, inaccessible, required missing or newer data is unavailable/recovery-required. No empty-store writeback. C02/C03/C10; 1/2/17/26; XS03/13.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: A `Promise.race` timeout in scheduler leaves the action running; clearing an in-memory in-flight set can admit overlapping work.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Durable attempts, fencing and one terminal deadline owner; retain late-charge/effect accounting. Do not release conflict capacity until stopped or effects are fenced. C04/C05/C11, ADR-239; 5/6/11/17; XS04/05.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: `llm-readiness.ts` makes real completion calls; bootstrap reacts to readiness/fingerprint changes. Provider checks can bypass the presumed scan/dream budget boundary.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: All provider dispatch, including readiness/bootstrap/narration/evaluation/plugin calls, passes the same admission seam. Unfunded probing is unknown/budget-blocked, not proof of readiness. C05/C06; 6/8/17; XS05/14.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: `engine.env`, startup `process.env`, mutable scheduler/event config and session settings have different persistence and precedence.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Define source precedence, revision-aware apply, pinned run policy and immediate restrictive revocation. Shared secrets are references, never copied into run snapshots. C07/C09; 7/10/11/23; XS06.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Discipline has a process-wide `activeSession`; Architect also has global active execution state. Selected-plan settings can leak between clients.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Session-scoped command context, independently durable execution/attempt identity and plan grants; sessionless protected mutations fail. Project scope has no invented plan. C09/C14; 11/12/21; XS07/08.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: C14 requires C15 receipts while exporting a lifecycle change can itself trigger reconciliation; unbounded self-dependency would prevent verification.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Verification checks its declared material effects. Its own typed event and export obligation commit together; derived status export cannot require itself to be verified again. C04/C14/C15; 5/21; XS08/09.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Managed shell/native editor/plugin effects are not fully described by prompts or a pre-write tool-name classifier; a filesystem change can precede graph recording.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Persist effect intent before controlled writes, observe after-state independently, use durable host outbox plus restart catch-up. Unobservable routes cannot claim managed C15 compliance. C15/C09; 5/12/25/30; XS09/10.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Dirty work is described in the plan but maintenance state currently holds timestamps/heads; stage completion and generation advancement lacked an exact join rule.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Separate invalidation, reconciliation and optional cognition debt; stage receipts clear only covered generation/input fingerprints. Derived outputs carry root cause and cannot create infinite admission. C04/C05/C15; 5/13–20/17; XS09/11.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Schedule runtime uses current mutable definitions, process-local claims and approximate due information. Trigger identity across DST/restart/edit was underspecified.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Immutable occurrence/run keys, one evaluator, snapshotted policy, explicit missed/overlap disposition and plugin-action version binding. C11; 17/29; XS05/11/12.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Accepted ADR-096 relaxes cold-start evidence; ADR-098 auto-probes; ADR-203 prioritizes connected models; several older v2 ADRs conflict with current or proposed semantics.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Explicit applicability/amendment register below. Preserve the reviewed Ashoka direction; do not silently change accepted ADR status or import unrelated accepted records as project law. C01/C06/C08; 0/7/8/15/25; XS14/15.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Python analytics directly unions JSON files; runtime metrics, graph coverage and lifecycle counts have different scopes/time bases.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Revisioned snapshot/export manifests and versioned denominators, never a mutable-directory read masquerading as a coherent snapshot. C01/C03/C08; 2/22/24/25; XS13/16.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: The host's in-process watchdog explicitly cannot interrupt synchronous plugin code. A trust gate is not effect confinement.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Qualify managed handlers through mediated effects and bounded execution; opaque legacy trusted handlers are visibly unattested and cannot satisfy managed execution gates. Hard-cancellable work uses an isolated worker boundary. C09/C15/C17; 11/12/25/31; XS10/17.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Migration text concentrated on graph IDs; config, schedules, plans, plugin state, receipts and analytics history need a common cutover inventory. Installer currently replaces shared `dist` and reminds users to restart.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Full family migration matrix, writer fence, marker-based recovery and version-pinned executable assets. Installation and per-instance data activation are separate. C02/C10; 26/28; XS18/19.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: CLI Computer Use may expose aggregate native events rather than every API call/screenshot. A worker watchdog does not control an unqualified native CLI runtime.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Capability-specific conformance with explicit evidence granularity, enforceable native grants, exclusive input seat and native stop. Missing mandatory controls block that route; no silent backend change. C17; 31; XS17/20.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: UI summary/detail, SSE, cached prompts and old clients can answer from different revisions; one transport's success can hide incomplete delivery.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Common revision vector, epoch/gap reset, permission-bound cursors and atomic surface adoption. Distinguish display cache from authority. C02/C03/C12/C14/C16; 1/12/21–25/29; XS07/13/16.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Source-only comparisons and full-client task runs could be declared complete at the early retrieval slice; paid/hardware qualification cannot be inferred from mocks.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Freeze rubric and fixtures early; run composed task and model evidence at final gates. Unknown pricing, absent hardware or withheld canary allocation remains a visible activation/release limit. C08; 0/4/9/25/27/31; XS01/14.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: Living cognition, external data/UI evidence, delivery/webhooks and historical plan artifacts can be flattened into a static index or recursively re-ingested as new evidence.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Preserve each cognitive owner and ancestry; scope external observations and generated exports; include delivery/replay and all 29 subsystem families in compound traces. C01/C15; 13–22/25; XS11/15/16.

closure_mapping.source_loose_end: `graph-health.ts` treats old scan/enrichment timestamps and raw commits/working-tree changes since the scan as drift, even when managed mutations have reconciled them.
closure_mapping.owning_correction_evidence: Freshness is evidence- and reconciliation-relative. Old scan does not equal stale graph; inclusive rescan after substantial out-of-band work is a user choice. Canonical last_graph_mutation_at is independent of last_full_scan_at and source-reconciliation coverage. C01/C03/C15/C12; 2/3/5/16/17/22–25/26; XS21.

migration_phases.state: v13.4 running data read-only; record instance, executable/config/source hashes, schema inventory and missing/unknown families
migration_phases.recovery: No mutation; unknown history remains unknown. Inspect known mismatches without inferring staleness from scan age.

migration_phases.state: Versioned migration manifest with exact conversions, ID map, unresolved scope, disk estimate, writer inventory and downgrade limits
migration_phases.recovery: Changed input invalidates preview; no migration without reviewed matching digest.

migration_phases.state: Quiesce v13 scans/cognition/clients, verify process exit or safe drain, acquire exclusive instance owner; backup every included family and config, test restore on a copy
migration_phases.recovery: Failure releases no new writer; untouched instance can run old code after verifying no commit occurred.

migration_phases.state: Convert into separate staging directory on suitable storage; chunk cursors and checksums; old active stores remain intact/read-only
migration_phases.recovery: Resume exact matching stage or discard it; disk full/cancel cannot publish half a format.

migration_phases.state: Validate references/counts/trust/ancestry/source-state/receipt invariants and supported old/new reader outputs against staged manifest
migration_phases.recovery: Failed validation preserves artifacts and reasons; no reinterpretation of unknown legacy evidence as success.

migration_phases.state: Revalidate fenced input, publish migration commit/active-format marker and receipt through core boundary
migration_phases.recovery: Before marker: old state. After marker: new committed state, finish recovery/validation; never guess by directory timestamps.

migration_phases.state: New pinned executable validates marker/schema, recovers journal/jobs/grants/outboxes before opening mutation admission
migration_phases.recovery: The supported launcher/owner fence prevents old binaries opening newly activated formats; do not assume unmodified v13 binaries themselves implement that protection. Incompatible clients get negotiated read/upgrade-required. Background paid work stays unadmitted until valid allocation/readiness.

migration_phases.state: New writes append receipts/history at new revisions; original backup retained with provenance
migration_phases.recovery: Revert readers/config via adapters or forward repair. After new writes, restoring old backup is forbidden unless a tested reviewed reconciliation preserves those writes.

migration_phases.state: Marker/stores disagree, rollback fails or evidence is corrupt
migration_phases.recovery: Instance recovery-required, writes fenced, explicit restore/forward-repair plan; no new empty graph or automatic full paid scan.

migration_families.family: Entity/relationship stores, UI, API, auxiliary and datastores
migration_families.conversion: Typed ID/origin mappings, inline links and duplicate classification, human curation, semantic anchors
migration_families.limits: Ambiguous collisions quarantine aliases; unavailable datastore observation does not delete previously known schema

migration_families.conversion: Source hashes, scanner contract, scope/eligibility denominator, attempt and committed outcome
migration_families.limits: Missing baseline limits that scan operation only; retain later valid reconciled knowledge. Offer separately selected structural reconstruction when needed. Fallback never becomes historical LLM success

migration_families.conversion: Preserve ancestry, review decisions, score meaning, contradictions, rejection/tombstones
migration_families.limits: No fabricated independent evidence or backdated verification; old thresholds retain their version

migration_families.conversion: Exact IDs and authored bytes, explicit checkpoints and approval/definition hashes; applicability inventory
migration_families.limits: Legacy prose is a claim, not typed success; imported or ambiguous ADR scope stays review-needed

migration_families.conversion: Validated key migration, original effective values, deployment overrides, opaque secret references
migration_families.limits: Invalid/newer configs block affected activation; no template reset or new paid/full-access/remote grant

migration_families.conversion: Definition IDs/revisions, old UTC intent, known runs, skipped/unknown claims and action versions
migration_families.limits: Active pre-upgrade attempts become recovery-required; no replay of missing occurrence history or model-fingerprint-triggered spend

migration_families.conversion: Known effects, reservations, durable scope and outstanding obligations
migration_families.limits: Old records lacking receipts stay unknown; all active leases/native handles expire, re-probe/re-authorize before resume

migration_families.conversion: Preserve generation/stage/cause records where present; coarse unresolved markers otherwise
migration_families.limits: Timestamps/Git heads alone cannot establish clean working-tree state; no invented processed generation

migration_families.conversion: Preserve raw history and denominator versions; rebuild indexes against canonical revision
migration_families.limits: Old report values remain historical; no silent conversion to new accuracy/readiness metrics

migration_families.conversion: Retain remote namespace, artifact hash, event and observation time, local validation
migration_families.limits: Duplicate imports deduplicate, unknown origin/time remains unknown; no relabeling foreign hypotheses as local facts

migration_families.family: Plugin namespaced state and webhook delivery
migration_families.conversion: Keep plugin/state schema revisions and event/operation/DLQ identity
migration_families.limits: Missing plugin blocks that action only; no re-send of unknown external effect; retained state survives unload

migration_families.conversion: No implied historical desktop grant; retain any recognized observation/receipt metadata only
migration_families.limits: Upgrade default disabled, all old handles/leases invalid; native API/CLI capabilities qualified anew
